problem: Australian government contractors can win commercially sound work but still face a mobilisation and milestone-payment cash gap before compliant invoices are accepted and paid.

targeting.primaryQuery: working capital finance government contract Australia
targeting.audience: Australian business owners and established SMEs delivering awarded government contracts

uniqueValue: Translates an awarded government contract into a cost-to-deliver, milestone and repayment timeline rather than treating headline contract value as cash.
Compares pre-delivery working capital, line-of-credit, trade and post-invoice structures with clear stop conditions.

evidence.summary: Queued governed release with an exact slug, recovered from the recorded source branch.
The Australian Government Department of Finance publishes the Commonwealth Procurement Rules governing Commonwealth procurement.
business.gov.au provides official guidance on preparing and understanding contracts.

measurement.successRule: Evidence of non-brand impressions/clicks or assisted service-page engagement at review.
measurement.exitRule: Consolidate or noindex only after complete review evidence shows persistent low value or material intent overlap.

approval.basis: Approved under the explicit two-article daily-content automation policy after governed backlog, source, scope and intent-ownership review.
